findings.text: follow-on: _record_release_on_ledger persists the release block at promotion.py:6845 and :5569 and _retire_disposable_identity runs only after it, so identity_retired/identity_member reach the returned payload but never the committed run row, unlike process_stopped_pid which is set inside _release_run_workspace before the persist.

justifications.evidence: tests/test_promotion_retires_a_disposable_identity.py asserts each done_when clause and its 3-passed result is recorded in the manifest together with the 9-passed arms and the logged negative control.
justifications.fit: _retire_disposable_identity and _manifest_reads_blocked at promotion.py:5243/5259 follow the surrounding release helpers and reuse ledger.load/ledger.write with allow_member_removal, adding no plan or ticket identifier.
justifications.goal_fidelity: promotion.py:6849-6852 retires the run's disposable-<run-id> roster row at acceptance and promotion.py:5437 records process_stopped_pid when the process group is signalled, matching the goal's acceptance half.
